# Technische Universität Chemnitz (TU Chemnitz)

> TU Chemnitz is a leading German technical university offering comprehensive academic programs, research opportunities, and student support services with modern digital infrastructure.

TU Chemnitz serves as a central hub for higher education in Chemnitz, Germany, providing students and researchers with access to academic resources, administrative services, and collaborative platforms. The university emphasizes integrated student services, modern e-learning capabilities, and secure network infrastructure through its IT services (URZ).

## Key Topics

- TU Chemnitz
- Student Services
- E-Learning (OPAL, BigBlueButton)

## University Overview

- [Technische Universität Chemnitz](https://www.tu-chemnitz.de): TU Chemnitz homepage with institution overview and library facilities
- [Technische Universität Chemnitz (English)](https://www.tu-chemnitz.de/index.html.en): TU Chemnitz English homepage with institution overview
- [University Profile](https://www.tu-chemnitz.de/tu): TU Chemnitz institutional profile covering programs, research, and teaching

## Student Services & Support

- [Student Service](https://www.tu-chemnitz.de/studierendenservice/studserv): Student services including enrollment, admission, and course management
- [Central Examination Office](https://www.tu-chemnitz.de/zpa): Exam registration and academic certificate services at TU Chemnitz
- [Student Counseling & Career Services](https://www.tu-chemnitz.de/beratung): Student counseling, academic advising, and career services
- [Job Portal](https://www.tu-chemnitz.de/career-service/jobboerse): Job portal for student positions, internships, and research assistant roles
- [Student Government (StuRa)](https://www.stura.tu-chemnitz.de): Student government and representation services at TU Chemnitz
- [Feedback Management](https://www.tu-chemnitz.de/tu/bms): Feedback management and complaint procedures at TU Chemnitz
